integrity: General lattice conservation and Hamiltonian structure are prior results; only the explicitly defined critical shear-period classification is assessed as the new contribution. Historical priority remains provisional, independent external validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Four-site periodic nearest-neighbor conservative phase ring; strict \(c,d>0\); statistics conditional on normalized Haar in a fixed invariant leaf; period modulo global rotation; no claim for arbitrary N, perturbations, or absolute phase recurrence.
title: Four-oscillator conservative rings: exact critical shear and an inverse-time period tail
